description.value:
You hurl a glob of acid to a point within range, where it bursts into a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d4 acid damage immediately and another 5d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn on a failure, or half the initial damage and no follow-up damage on a success.

Cast with a tech slot of 5th level or higher, the initial damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 4th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 4
